references.text: Abraham's servant praises the Lord for His חֶסֶד (grace) and אֱמֶת (faithfulness) - exactly the same word pair that Jacob uses in his prayer, showing a consistent recognition of God's grace and truth in the history of the patriarchs.
God promised Jacob to be with him, protect him, and bring him back to the land. Jacob's humble acknowledgment of God's grace and faithfulness reflects the fulfillment of this promise.
The Lord instructed Jacob to return to his fathers' land and assured him of His presence, which Jacob now acknowledges with gratitude.
Jacob recognizes that God's grace and protection preserved him in the conflict with Laban, and acknowledges that his wealth is due to God's faithfulness.
Jacob became very rich with large flocks, servants, camels, and donkeys - a concrete fulfillment of the blessing he describes: from one staff over Jordan to two camps.
David expresses similar humility before God: 'Who am I, Lord God, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?' - a strong parallel to Jacob's humble acknowledgment of God's grace.

The psalmist expresses trust that goodness and mercy will follow him all the days of his life, a thematic parallel to Jacob's recognition that God's grace and faithfulness have followed him all the way.
Theological connection between Jacob's expansion from one man to two camps and God's expansion of the 'servant's' mission from Israel to the whole world.
Contrast between God's blessing that expands boundaries (Jacob) and human injustice that moves boundary stones (Hosea).
Contrast between the staff as a symbol of God's expansion (Genesis) and the staff as a symbol of the people's breaking (Zechariah).
Theological contrast between humility leading to blessing (Genesis) and God's hand diminishing and handing over in punishment (Ezekiel).
Contrast between God's hand that blesses (Genesis) and God's hand that destroys (Jeremiah), illustrating God's dual role.
Theological parallel on God's abundant grace: Jacob feels unworthy of the blessing, just as David received more than he could have expected.
